title: Impedance of a series RLC circuit
caption: Resistance R = 30 Ω lies along the horizontal, the inductive reactance X_L = 80 Ω points up and X_C = 40 Ω points down, so the net reactance is X = 40 Ω. Z = √(30² + 40²) = 50 Ω, the current is 100/50 = 2 A, and the voltage leads the current by φ = 53.1° (tan φ = 40/30).
alt: Phasor-style diagram: R = 30 ohms to the right, X_L = 80 up and X_C = 40 down, with the resultant impedance 50 ohms at 53.1 degrees above R.
description: R = 30 Ω is drawn to the right.
X_L = 80 Ω is drawn up (voltage leads current in an inductor) and X_C = 40 Ω down (it lags).
The resultant is Z = √(30² + 40²) = 50 Ω at φ = 53.1° above R. I = 100/50 = 2 A, lagging the voltage.
